subject: Guest RSVP stripped and organizer mismatch — manual passcode & reschedule
body:
From: Akram Qureshi <akram.qureshi@brightmap.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:07:00 -0400
Subject: Issue with calendar invite — guests seeing 'Join token missing'

Hi Jordan,

Quick heads up — we tried to join the demo you scheduled for tomorrow (May 15, 11:00 AM ET) and several of our external guests get an error on the calendar entry: the Meet link shows up but when they click it the app reports "Join token missing" and the RSVP status is blanked out for them. Maria (cc'd) saw the organizer show as her personal account instead of Redwood's demo host.

We don't have org-level SSO restrictions on our side, so my guess is organizer metadata got mangled during a cross-domain calendar sync. Can you resend an invite with the organizer set to a Redwood-managed address? If that's a hassle, switching the session to a Zoom link with an explicit passcode would also work for us.

Also attaching a quick screenshot of the error and the attendee list.

Thanks — Akram
BrightMap (BD-4921)
Attachment: screenshot-token-missing.png (image stub)


-----Original internal note copied below-----

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Akram Qureshi <akram.qureshi@brightmap.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:42:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Issue with calendar invite — guests seeing 'Join token missing'

Hi Akram — thanks for the quick report and the screenshot.

Short answer: we can do both options but recommend switching to Zoom for this session to avoid calendar-organizer edge cases (cross-domain Meet organizer shadowing keeps cropping up).

Plan: 
- I'll create a new invite from redwood.demos@redwood.com (our managed demo host) and set the organizer explicitly.
- I'll include a Zoom meeting link and a short numeric passcode in the invite body so guests can join if the calendar token still misbehaves.
- Ben, can you attach the latest deck and the meeting .ics snapshot when you send the new invite?
- Akram/Maria: does 11:00 AM ET still work or would you prefer 11:30 AM ET?

I want to avoid the organizer handoff that caused this — the trace shows the original invite was forwarded from Maria's calendar which likely stripped the token for external attendees. Creating a fresh invite from our managed account should close the loop.

I'll hold off sending until I get a confirmation on the time.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
